songs.comment_text: Played at the funeral of my beautiful brother, aged 33.  Even 8 years later to remember the sight at least 30 soldiers crying to this, as the flyover and bagpipes played will remain with me forever. May all those who served and gave the ultimate sacrifice, rest in peace  xx
